description: This file contains PHP functions for generating XML, HTML, and WML representations of system memory and swap information, utilizing global variables and external functions.

methods.name: xml_memory
methods.description: Generates an XML string representing current system memory and swap usage details.

methods.name: html_memory
methods.description: Creates an HTML table displaying system memory and swap information with graphical bar representations.

methods.name: wml_memory
methods.description: Produces a WML card summarizing system memory and swap usage for mobile devices.
